s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive neurological decline with motor and speech impairment
salient_findings: Episodes of spasms and tremors in the right hand and forearm
Extensive nonenhancing lesions in the bilateral cerebral hemispheres on MRI
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her mid-60s
Initial presentation with episodes of spasms and tremors in the right hand and forearm
Underwent carpal tunnel release surgery
Tremors recurred 7 months later
Developed progressive right-sided weakness, dysarthria, hand tremors, slurred speech, and gait instability over 3 months
Brain MRI showed hyperintensities throughout the bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter, corpus callosum, basal ganglia, thalami, midbrain, upper pons, and middle cerebellar peduncles
T1-weighted fluid-attenuated inversion recovery MRI with contrast showed absence of contrast enhancement
Brain biopsy revealed CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ EBV/EBER− cells
Cerebrospinal fluid contained lymphoma cells
Bone marrow was negative for lymphoma cells

shortlist.label: Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Brain biopsy revealed CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ EBV/EBER− cells and cerebrospinal fluid contained lymphoma cells

shortlist.label: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Brain MRI showed hyperintensities throughout the bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter, corpus callosum, basal ganglia, thalami, midbrain, upper pons, and middle cerebellar peduncles

shortlist.label: Gliomatosis Cerebri
shortlist.why_kept: Extensive nonenhancing lesions in the bilateral cerebral hemispheres and brain MRI findings

shortlist.label: Neurolymphomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive neurological decline with motor and speech impairment and presence of lymphoma cells in cerebrospinal fluid

shortlist.label: Intravascular Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive right-sided weakness, dysarthria, hand tremors, slurred speech, and gait instability with lymphoma cells in cerebrospinal fluid

raw.rationale: The presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and the brain biopsy showing CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ EBV/EBER− cells, along with the imaging findings of extensive nonenhancing lesions in the bilateral cerebral hemispheres, are consistent with Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma.

rejected.label: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy
rejected.why: Typically associated with immunocompromised state and presence of JC virus, not mentioned in the case

rejected.label: Gliomatosis Cerebri
rejected.why: Usually shows contrast enhancement on MRI and has a different histological appearance

rejected.label: Neurolymphomatosis
rejected.why: Involves the peripheral nervous system, which is not mentioned in the case

rejected.label: Intravascular Lymphoma
rejected.why: Typically presents with multiple infarcts and has a different histological appearance
